meta.description:
Jakarta pumps much of its water from the ground, and the ground is giving way, up to 25 cm a year in the north. About 40% of the city already sits below sea level, and Indonesia is moving its capital. The final seconds show a projection for 2050.

Watch our planet change in seconds. Accelerated urban growth, geographic shifts and climate overviews from a clean satellite perspective.

📍 Jakarta, Indonesia · 1990 → 2024, projection to 2050
